Cautiously positive tone with clear downside risks. The FOMC highlights a strong labor market and robust household spending, but also weak business fixed investment and exports and inflation running below the 2 percent objective with low market-based inflation compensation. In New Keynesian frameworks (Gali and Gertler, 1999; Woodford, 2003), below-target inflation with anchored expectations warrants accommodation; the rate cut and ample-reserves operations transmit through interest-rate and liquidity channels to support real activity (Christiano, Eichenbaum, and Evans, 2005; Sims, 1992). However, the literature on investment frictions and financing constraints (Kashyap, Lamont, and Stein, 1994) underscores that weak capex can propagate cyclical softness despite lower rates. Balancing these, the overall sentiment is modestly positive but restrained.
